task: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First step, make absolutely sure that the antique trunk within the bedroom is opened. After that, take the old key from the antique trunk. Once you have picked up the old key, unlock the wooden door in the bedroom with the old key. And then, open the wooden door inside the bedroom. And then, make an effort to go east. That done, open the screen door. After that, attempt to go to the east. That done, take a trip south. After that, pick-up the lettuce from the floor of the garden. After that, try to head north. With that done, head west. Then, rest the lettuce on the stove. And once you've done that, you win!
